Therefore the equation qualifies as scientifically novel relative to the classical reference.

[CANDIDATE EQUATION]:
Reff = R0 * (1 - q * (1 - exp(-gamma * d))) * (1 - q / (q + kappa + eta * q * d)) * (1 + beta * exp(-gamma * d) * (1 - q)) * (1 + phi * (1 - exp(-alpha * a))) * (1 + rho * (1 - q) * (1 - exp(-gamma * d)) / (1 + sigma * q))
